llm_response.reason: The website imitates a high-end lingerie boutique ('Aubade'), but displays multiple signs of an online shopping scam: (1) No physical business address or phone number is provided—only a generic email form; (2) Payment is restricted to credit cards only, with an apologetic note about PayPal not being available—common for scam sites as PayPal offers buyer protection; (3) The payment/legal/contact information is extremely vague, lacking legal entity registration or address, violating e-commerce norms; (4) Urgency and psychological comfort tactics are used, such as '100% secure shopping' and free shipping threshold; (5) SSL certificate issues appear on subpages, which another red flag; (6) The domain was created just one month ago, with all registration info hidden and the registrant is in China, conflicting with the supposed German/French branding; (7) The site misuses a legitimate brand's name and imagery, likely without authorization. Combined, these factors strongly point toward a scam/fake shopping website.
